note: Prompts end with a no-follow-up clause because evals run headless (claude -p). Real users can answer questions.

evals.name: audit-job-seeker
evals.prompt: My LinkedIn profile is in profile.txt (copied from the PDF export) and jd1.txt / jd2.txt are two ML engineer jobs I'm targeting. Audit my profile and rewrite it so I start getting interviews for ML engineer roles. I can't answer follow-up questions right now, so make reasonable assumptions, note them, and save everything you produce in this folder.
evals.expected_output: Scored audit tied to the ML engineer goal, keyword gaps from both JDs, 3 headline options under 220 chars, About and experience rewrites with no invented metrics (placeholders instead), HTML report, workspace files.

evals.name: follow-founder
evals.prompt: I'm Tom Becker, co-founder and CEO of SiteLoop, project management software for mid-size commercial construction contractors in the US (think $20M-$200M general contractors). I want LinkedIn to put me in front of construction operations leaders, project executives and owners of GC firms. Who specifically should I follow and engage with on LinkedIn, and how should I engage? I can't answer follow-up questions right now, so make reasonable assumptions and save what you produce in this folder.
evals.expected_output: Tiered list of real accounts with LinkedIn URLs seen in search results, evidence of recent activity, a not-verified list, a concrete daily engagement routine, people.md saved.

evals.name: analyze-priya
evals.prompt: I exported my LinkedIn data archive and my analytics (both files are in the data/ folder). I'm a fractional CFO for seed to Series A SaaS startups and I want more founders to hire me. What's actually working in my content, what should I change, and is my profile helping? I can't answer follow-up questions right now, so make reasonable assumptions and save what you produce in this folder.
evals.expected_output: Parses both exports, joins text to metrics, personal benchmarks with sample sizes, audience-fit finding (few CFO/founder buyers vs target), profile misalignment (generic headline/About), off-topic posts underperform, dashboard, learnings saved.

evals.name: ideas-priya
evals.prompt: I'm a fractional CFO for seed to Series A SaaS startups (my LinkedIn data archive is in data/). Give me a month of LinkedIn post ideas that will get founders to hire me, and write the first post so it's ready to publish. I can't answer follow-up questions right now, so make reasonable assumptions and save what you produce in this folder.
evals.expected_output: Ideas grounded in her real stories from Shares.csv, hooks, pillars, a calendar at sustainable cadence, one post in her voice that passes the checker with no invented facts.
